expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: a 10-minute limit logged members out mid-checkout and lost
their pantry orders, which is why the limit is 30 minutes.
expectations.evidence: The message only says "The docs retain the history of checkout logouts under the previous 10-minute limit," which frames this as a docs note rather than a warning. It never mentions lost pantry orders or that the incident is why the limit became 30 minutes. It also never warns that going back to 10 minutes brings that problem back, and it made the change without asking.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/sessions.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/sessions.md at step 6; first edit at step 11
